question: Use of an attractive masquerade or mask is associated with which of the following dance style?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kathakali.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kathakali:-**​

 
 
• ​It is a major form of classical Indian dance.
 
• It is a blend of dance, music, and acting and dramatizes stories, which are mostly adapted from Indian epics.
 
• It is distinguished by the elaborately colorful make-up, costumes, and face masks that the traditionally male actor-dancers wear.
 
• The dancers enact the roles (kings, gods, demons, etc.) of the stories with particular make-up and costume, the vocalists narrate the legend and the percussionists play the musical instruments.
 
• Other dances of Kerala- Mohiniyattam, Thirvathirakali, Kolkali, Ottamthullal, Koodiyattam, Chakyar Koothu, Oppana.
